steps.title: Stack in the middle
steps.rule: Everyone stacks in the centre to be wrapped by Cruel Coil.

steps.title: Stretch your chain
steps.cue: the chain tether and Unbreakable Flesh land on you
steps.rule: DPS (α) run out of the coil a quarter turn counter-clockwise from the current gap, where it opens next. Supports (β) step 8m the opposite way, toward the previous gap, so the chain snaps.

steps.title: Soak the chain tower
steps.cue: a chain snaps and leaves a tower
steps.rule: The support who snapped the chain walks back to the middle. The support two numbers later (First for Third, Second for Fourth, Third for First, Fourth for Second) steps 7m out onto the tower left where the chain broke.

steps.title: Walk to your outer blob
steps.rule: First and Second in Line DPS, now outside, walk around the outside of the coil to the outer blobs: First takes the third blob, Second the fourth. Never cut through the coil.

steps.title: Soak an inner blob
steps.cue: Roiling Mass cast starts on the blob
steps.rule: Third and Fourth in Line DPS, still inside the coil, soak the two inner blobs before leaving: Third takes the first blob, Fourth the second.

steps.title: Back to the middle
steps.rule: After soaking a chain tower, walk back into the centre of the coil.

steps.title: Back to the middle
steps.rule: After soaking an inner blob, walk back into the centre of the coil.

steps.title: Get out before Constrictor
steps.rule: After the last Skinsplitter, every support leaves the coil the same way they stretched their chain; nobody may stay inside.

steps.title: Regroup
steps.rule: Stack back in the centre once the coil opens.
